video.title: AI欧腐《爱上我的恶魔室友/Fallen for My Demon Roommate》
video.desc:
After six millennia of bitter warfare and strife between Heaven and Hell, the two realms finally agree to sign a formal peace treaty. As the first step toward peaceful coexistence, Heaven dispatches its chief archangel Gabriel — affectionately known as Gal — to Hell Academy as an exchange student. Azazel, a high-ranking demon, is assigned to serve as his guide and handler during his stay. When a rigid, rule-abiding angel with a saintly aura and an endearingly oblivious streak crosses paths with the academy’s rebellious, sharp-tongued demon heartthrob who hides a soft, sweet side beneath his tough exterior, their clashing cultures, beliefs and daily habits spark a string of absurd, side-splitting misadventures all across campus. Amid their chaotic, uproarious day-to-day lives, the two gradually grow closer. Together, they foil a sabotage plot orchestrated by the conservative demon faction, and a fiery, cross-species romance blooms between them. When his one-month exchange program draws to a close, Gal returns to Heaven with great reluctance, unaware that the second phase of the Peace Treaty is already underway. This time, it is the demon’s turn to cross the divide, journeying to Heaven to find the angel who belongs only to him.
天堂与地狱经历了长达六千年的残酷战争与纷争后，终于同意签署一份正式的和平条约。
作为迈向和平共处的第一步，天堂派出首席大天使 Gabriel——大家亲切地称他为 Gal——前往地狱学院担任交换生。地位显赫的恶魔 Azazel 则被指派为他在地狱期间的向导兼负责人。
一个严谨守规、浑身散发圣洁气息，却迟钝得可爱的天使；一个叛逆毒舌、备受瞩目的恶魔万人迷，强硬外表下却藏着温柔甜蜜的一面。当两人在校园中相遇，文化、信仰和生活习惯上的巨大差异不断碰撞，引发了一连串荒诞离奇、令人捧腹的校园闹剧。
在鸡飞狗跳、笑料百出的日常生活中，两人的距离逐渐拉近。他们携手挫败了恶魔保守派策划的破坏阴谋，一段炽热的跨种族恋情也就此悄然绽放。
为期一个月的交换生活结束后，Gal 万般不舍地返回天堂，却不知道和平条约的第二阶段已经正式启动。
这一次，轮到恶魔跨越两界的界限，前往天堂，寻找那个只属于他的天使。
